text:
alex: Heads-up — seeing a 4xx spike on /api/generate since ~09:10, mostly 429 and 408. Anyone know the quickest dashboards/traces to check? Need to decide if alert thresholds should be tweaked.

sam: Check Grafana: <https://grafana.redwood.net/d/obs/errors-overview?panel=4&var_route=/api/generate> and the route heatmap: <https://grafana.redwood.net/d/obs/route-heatmap?var_route=/api/generate>. For traces use Datadog APM: search service:inference-gateway operation:generate and filter span.status:error.

maria: Quick triage steps: 1) compare requests/s to errors to rule out traffic surge, 2) check model-pool-utilization dashboard, 3) sample 5 traces around spikes (Datadog) and look for queueing/timeout spans.

sam: Query for logs: Logs > Generate service filter: service:gateway AND http.status_code:[400 TO 499] AND route:"/api/generate". For 429s look for header 'x-rate-limit-*' to see client throttling.

alex: @sam @maria thanks. Any idea if we should silence the current alert — it's noisy for 400s caused by bad client payloads?

maria: If it's 400/401 from specific client ids, add an exclusion tag to the alert: AND NOT client.id:internal-testing. If it's transient 408/429, raise the evaluation window to 5m and bump threshold to 1.5% to reduce flapping.

jen: SRE-bot posted runbook link for 4xx spike: <https://confluence.redwood.com/ops/4xx-triage>. Also if you need quick trace samples run: datadog-cli trace sample --service inference-gateway --query "resource:generate AND error:true" --limit 5

sre-bot: ALERT (auto): 4xx_rate for /api/generate > 2% over 1m at 1824001122. Runbook: <https://confluence.redwood.com/ops/4xx-triage>

alex: I'll take this and adjust alert to 5m window + exclude client.id:internal-testing for now. Will post PR for the alert change and ping oncall. :thumbsup:

sam: If you need a quick dashboard snippet to add to the runbook I can paste a panel query.

alex: Please do, thanks.
